Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Priyom (Security) and Monica (Solutions) to provide the artifacts and confirm details. Quick answers up front: 

- Yes — our hosted offering supports region-specific data residency and can be configured to keep customer data in EU regions only. We do not replicate data to non-EU regions by default for customers who select EU residency.
- VPC/private deployments: supported. We offer a VPC private deployment package that runs within customer VPCs (VPC peering or AWS PrivateLink) and supports private subnets and customer firewall controls.
- CMEK: supported via AWS KMS; HSM/backing options available for enterprise customers.

Priyom/Monica — can you attach the SOC2 summary, SIG/CAIQ answers, a network diagram and the VPC deployment checklist? Also please confirm any limitations around backups/cross-region DR.

Hi Alice — thanks, happy to provide details. See answers and attachments below.

Summary (TL;DR):
- EU-only residency: Redwood supports strict EU regional isolation for hosted customers. For Acme, we can pin all data-plane resources to eu-west-1 (AWS) and disable cross-region backups by default.
- Backups & DR: cross-region backups are optional and disabled unless requested. For customers that require cross-region DR we provide an explicit opt-in and document the controls.
- VPC/private deployment controls: We provide a private deployment package that installs runtime components into your VPC via an operator. Features include private subnets, security groups defined by the customer, VPC peering or PrivateLink, NAT gating, and optional egress-only endpoints.
- Key management: CMEK is supported; customers can supply AWS KMS keys (customer-owned) with automatic key rotation hooks. For HSM-backed keys we integrate with supported HSM providers (via KMS or direct HSM integration) under an enterprise contract.
- Logs & audit: all access and audit logs can be shipped to customer-controlled CloudWatch/CloudTrail S3 buckets; we also provide syslog/ELK forwarders for private deployments.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-type2-summary-2025.pdf, redwood-sig-responses-2026-03.pdf, vpc-deploy-checklist-20260315.xlsx, redwood-dataflow-eu-2026-03-15.pdf (network diagram)

Limitations / notes:
- If Acme opts for the hosted (shared control plane) model, metadata (routing and control plane records) may be stored in a regional control plane tied to EU; however sensitive payloads and logs will remain in the pinned data region. If you need a fully private control plane (no Redwood-managed control plane), our Private offering supports customer-owned control plane/air-gapped deployments under an enterprise agreement.
- For SOC 2 artifacts: the summary is attached; full reports are available under NDA.

Next steps:
1) I've attached the docs and a high-level network diagram.
2) Suggest a 30-min call with our infra engineer to walk through VPC peering and KMS steps. Availability: Tue/Wed morning UTC — propose Mar 17 at 10:00 UTC.

Thanks — Priyom

Alice — thanks for the quick follow-ups. Attached & answers inline.

1) Residency statement (attached): "Redwood Inference confirms that for the Acme Corp account, all customer data, derivatives, and backups will be stored only in AWS eu-west-1. Redwood will not replicate or transfer customer data outside the European Union unless Acme Corp provides explicit written opt-in." (see redwood-data-residency-eu-2026-03-15.pdf)

2) CMEK / key access: by default Redwood cannot access customer-owned KMS keys. We support customer-managed KMS keys with no blanket key escrow. For limited support activities that may require temporary key access we offer a documented process: (a) split custody (customer provides a short-lived grant), or (b) time-limited support key escrow under an SOW/NDA with key-use audit logs. We prefer option (a) for most customers.

3) Cross-region DR enablement: replication is opt-in and requires written approval from an authorized Acme contact; it is performed as a controlled operation with documented change control, and customers receive notification + ability to review the replication configuration before it is enabled.

4) High-res network diagram: attached (redwood-dataflow-eu-2026-03-15.pdf). I've also attached the SOC2 summary and SIG/CAIQ responses. For full SOC2 we can start an NDA if you need the report.

Next steps:

- If the residency statement and diagrams meet your needs we can proceed to procurement drafts.
